name: Concept Explainer
description: A visual, hands-on simulation of a concept — see it work, not just read about it.
briefPlaceholder: What concept should be explained? Physics, math, a mechanism, an algorithm — and who it's for...
promptScaffold:
This job produces an INTERACTIVE CONCEPT EXPLAINER exhibit — a visual, hands-on simulation.
- Model the concept from the brief visually (canvas or SVG animation) so users can SEE the behavior in motion.
- Give users controls (sliders, toggles, draggable elements) that change the simulation in real time, so cause and effect are explorable.
- Add brief captions or a step-through mode explaining what is happening at each stage.
- Favor scientific/mechanical accuracy over spectacle; state simplifications in a small 'About this model' note.
